race.creraces.elf.name: Elf
race.creraces.elf.description: Graceful beings with a deep connection to nature and magic. Elves possess extreme agility and speed but are sensitive to cold iron and metals.

race.creraces.orc.name: Orc
race.creraces.orc.description: Fierce warrior of the horde. High damage and sturdy.
race.creraces.undead.name: Undead
race.creraces.undead.description: Risen from the grave with dark powers. The Undead can summon ghouls, breathe underwater, and gain health by killing. They cannot regenerate health naturally and burn in direct sunlight.

race.creraces.golem.name: Golem
race.creraces.golem.description: A construct of animate matter. Golems are immune to many status effects and take no fall damage, but they are heavy and sink in water.
race.creraces.autumn_fairy.name: Autumn Fairy
race.creraces.autumn_fairy.description: Fey spirits of the harvest season. They can glide with their wings and have an affinity for decay and change.
race.creraces.axolotl.name: Axolotl
race.creraces.axolotl.description: Amphibious folk with incredible regenerative abilities. They thrive in water and rain but dry out quickly on land.
race.creraces.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
race.creraces.dragonborn.description: Proud descendants of dragons. They possess a breath weapon corresponding to their draconic ancestry and are resistant to that element.
race.creraces.dragonborn_air.name: Air Dragonborn
race.creraces.dragonborn_air.description: Descendants of storm dragons. They can unleash a breath of lightning and are resistant to thunder and lightning damage.
race.creraces.dragonborn_earth.name: Earth Dragonborn
race.creraces.dragonborn_earth.descripti: Descendants of deep dragons. They can unleash a breath of acid and are resistant to acid and poison.
race.creraces.dragonborn_fire.name: Fire Dragonborn
race.creraces.dragonborn_fire.descriptio: Descendants of red dragons. They can unleash a cone of fire and are entirely immune to fire damage.
race.creraces.dragonborn_water.name: Water Dragonborn
race.creraces.dragonborn_water.descripti: Descendants of sea dragons. They can unleash a chilling breath and are resistant to cold damage. They can also breathe underwater.
race.creraces.elementalist.name: Elementalist
race.creraces.elementalist.description: Mages attuned to the primal elements. They can manipulate fire, water, earth, and air to suit their needs.
race.creraces.fairy.name: Fairy
race.creraces.fairy.description: Tiny magical tricksters. Fairies can fly and are hard to hit, but they have very low health and physical strength.
race.creraces.giant.name: Giant
race.creraces.giant.description: Massive humanoids with strength to match their size. Giants have increased reach and health but are slow and easy targets.
race.creraces.lycan.name: Lycan
race.creraces.lycan.description: Cursed wanderers who transform under the moon. Lycans gain immense power at night but are vulnerable to silver and wolfsbane.
race.creraces.mermaid.name: Mermaid
race.creraces.mermaid.description: Denizens of the deep ocean. Mermaids move swiftly in water and can charm sailors, but they are helpless on land.
race.creraces.pixie.name: Pixie
race.creraces.pixie.description: Smaller, faster cousins of fairies. Pixies are constantly airborne and possess innate magic, though they are extremely fragile.
race.creraces.ratkin.name: Ratkin
race.creraces.ratkin.description: Scurrying folk of the sewers. Ratkins are immune to poison and hunger, adept at hiding in the shadows.
race.creraces.slime.name: Slime
race.creraces.slime.description: Sentient ooze that can split and reform. Slimes bounce on impact and can squeeze through tight spaces.
race.creraces.spring_fairy.name: Spring Fairy
race.creraces.spring_fairy.description: Fey spirits of bloom and growth. They bring life wherever they fly and have a natural affinity for flowers.
race.creraces.summer_fairy.name: Summer Fairy
race.creraces.summer_fairy.description: Fey spirits of warmth and light. They radiate heat and are most active during the day.
race.creraces.troll.name: Troll
race.creraces.troll.description: Brutish regenerators of the deep caves. Trolls heal wounds rapidly and are strong, but fire and acid halt their regeneration.
race.creraces.velox.name: Velox
race.creraces.velox.description: Creatures of speed and momentum. Velox move faster the longer they run but struggle to stop or turn quickly.
race.creraces.winter_fairy.name: Winter Fairy
race.creraces.winter_fairy.description: Fey spirits of snow and ice. They are immune to the cold and can freeze water with a touch.
ability.creraces.boost_morale.name: Boost Morale
ability.creraces.boost_morale.descriptio: Grants Strength and Speed to yourself and nearby allies.
ability.creraces.cowardly_skirmish.name: Cowardly Skirmish
ability.creraces.cowardly_skirmish.descr: Gain Speed and Haste. Recast to slow and weaken nearby enemies.
ability.creraces.crescent_swivel.name: Crescent Swivel
ability.creraces.crescent_swivel.descrip: Perform a spinning attack dealing 4.0 damage.
ability.creraces.deadly_venom.name: Deadly Venom
ability.creraces.deadly_venom.descriptio: Inflict Poison and Wither on enemies you hit.
ability.creraces.fire_slash.name: Fire Slash
ability.creraces.fire_slash.description: Ignite enemies in front of you.
ability.creraces.slash_n_dash.name: Slash n' Dash
ability.creraces.water_breathing.name: Water Breathing
